title: Distribution of a selected restriction batch
statement: Let $n,M,R$ be natural numbers, let $f$ map sign vectors on $n$ coordinates to signs, let $P$ be a set of coordinates, and fix a sign assignment $z$ on $P$. Given a batch of $R$ assignments on $P$, suppose at least $M$ entries equal $z$. Select $M$ such entries by the specified order-preserving selection, and use their corresponding free-coordinate assignments to form a batch of labeled restrictions under $f$. When the original batch of free-coordinate assignments is uniform, the resulting labeled batch has the same distribution as a batch formed by choosing $M$ free-coordinate assignments uniformly and labeling each by its restriction under $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from sign vectors on $n$ coordinates to signs
$P$ is a set of coordinates among the $n$ indices
The batch of $R$ fixed assignments contains at least $M$ copies of $z$
